definitions: 关于；就……而言；在……方面（with regard(s) to）

examples.text: How the events of Ocarina of Time's story are remembered in-universe is actually very important with regards to the game's timeline placement.
examples.explanation: 这里 with regards to 表示“关于、就……而言”，说明“这些事件在游戏宇宙内如何被记住”这一点，对于讨论游戏时间线位置很重要。

source.text: Ocarina of Time Remake Trailer Analysis
